name: runtime-rss-units
goal: Record process peak RSS in bytes across Bun and Node without accepting the macOS Bun scaling error.

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Raw Bun 1.2.18 on Darwin reports rss 23,199,744 bytes and maxRSS 23,232,512, while Node 25.9 reports rss 47,497,216 bytes and maxRSS 46,384 KiB. The shared profiler multiplies both by 1024, producing impossible 300GB Bun observations.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Existing profile and runner tests require positive memory only. Extend the normal Vitest/Bun runner fixture to record independent fresh-process RSS byte references and bound recorded peaks to that scale; extend the existing real rank boundary case to reject impossible multi-gigabyte memory for its tiny fresh workload.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: bf56ed73f proof 9ded5d0c records two real failures: the source runner reports 113,833,410,560 bytes against a fresh-process scale bound of 889,454,592; the real rank process reports 335,728,869,376 bytes against its 8GiB sanity ceiling. Other cases pass. These are unit-scale guards, not wider performance budgets.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Centralize true process-peak RSS conversion in the existing profiling service. Preserve Bun/Darwin native bytes; convert the KiB reports from Node and other supported hosts. Reuse it for sampled observations, repeated profiles, unit benchmarks and history-index workloads. Mark the corrected memory method explicitly and retain old records unchanged.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: PerformanceProfileService now owns peakProcessRssBytes: Bun/Darwin native bytes remain bytes; KiB reports are converted once. Observations, repeated profiles and UnitBenchmarkService reuse it. Corrected memory methods explicitly state normalization, so prior incompatible measurements remain distinguishable.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: 651daf526 proof eb39fd48 passes all 17 unchanged runner and real rank benchmark cases; the end-to-end slowdown guard still passes. Another 20 lifecycle, sampling, transformation and profiler-service cases pass with profiling requested. Old records are retained and affected Bun memory values cannot establish budgets.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: Fresh isolated recurrence fails unfixed bf56ed73f with 4bdf596c and passes restored 651daf526 with d21bdb46. Command, test/config corpus and environment remain identical. The byte-reference runner and tiny-workload scale assertions reject the original 1024x conversion. Full corrected-source verification remains pending.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
